import pandas as pd

def select_indicators():
    # Load the input files
    metadata = pd.read_csv('inputs/eurostat/metadata_tables.csv')
    descriptions = pd.read_csv('inputs/eurostat/indicator_descriptions.csv')

    # Merge the metadata and descriptions to get all relevant information
    merged = pd.merge(metadata, descriptions, on='indicator_id')

    # Define the themes we are interested in
    themes = ['mobility', 'population_density', 'environment', 'living_conditions']

    # Filter the indicators based on the themes
    relevant_indicators = merged[merged['theme'].isin(themes)]

    # Select 10-15 indicators (here we select 12 for variety)
    selected_indicators = relevant_indicators.head(12)

    # Define the justification and expected_direction for each indicator
    # This is a simplified example; in a real scenario, you would have more detailed justifications
    justification_dict = {
        'mobility': 'Indicators related to transportation and commuting within urban areas.',
        'population_density': 'Indicators measuring the population density in urban areas.',
        'environment': 'Indicators related to environmental quality and sustainability in urban areas.',
        'living_conditions': 'Indicators measuring the quality of life and living conditions in urban areas.'
    }

    expected_direction_dict = {
        'mobility': 'higher_is_better',
        'population_density': 'contextual',
        'environment': 'higher_is_better',
        'living_conditions': 'higher_is_better'
    }

    selected_indicators['justification'] = selected_indicators['theme'].map(justification_dict)
    selected_indicators['expected_direction'] = selected_indicators['theme'].map(expected_direction_dict)

    # Select the required columns and save to the output file
    output_columns = ['indicator_id', 'indicator_name', 'theme', 'justification', 'expected_direction']
    selected_indicators[output_columns].to_csv('outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv', index=False, quoting=1)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    select_indicators()
